newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance Capital sets private placement.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance Capital sets private placement.

text.p: Renaissance Capital Growth & Income Fund III Inc said Tuesday it had privately placed a $2.3 million debenture with Integrated Security Systems Inc.
The company said the debenture will be convertible into its common stock at $1.05 per share.
It said Integrated will use the proceeds of the funding to acquire Golston Co, a producer of plastic molded products.
The current market price of Integrated is $3.125 per share and the indicated market value of the Renaissance position is $6.8 million, it said.
Integrated, based in Irving, Texas, makes traffic control equipment and other security equipment.
